entries.fe303089ff0a89fd: It sets out "Transforming education and giving children the strength to live" as its corporate philosophy, and its mission is to eradicate educational disparities. In addition to developing and providing learning materials, it states that it will accelerate the development and provision of new materials and services, such as consulting for the use of EdTech in educational settings, the use of big data such as learning history, and further use of AI, and establish a unique position. It also measures, visualizes and communicates what effects it brings to the 4 social issues of "school non-attendance," "developmental disabilities," "low academic achievement" and "poverty."
